name: ImQual
description: A web service and evaluation framework for measuring image quality and benchmarking image quality assessment (IQA) metrics across images and datasets.
evaluation_method: Correlation with human judgements (Spearman / Pearson), RMSE against MOS
general_score_metric: Spearman Rank-Order Correlation Coefficient (SROCC) and Pearson Linear Correlation Coefficient (PLCC)
typical_sota_score: varies by dataset; top metrics often attain SROCC ≈ 0.8–0.98
reputation: Used in the image quality assessment community as an evaluation framework, with moderate adoption.
notes: Non-LLM vision benchmark; dependent on subjective MOS ground truth, susceptible to dataset bias and potential saturation on synthetic distortions.
